description: Reopen r-sort-3b-nulls (General) read-only. Table-type walks reading ID of index IX forward and backward on NI3 (K, N IGNORE NULL), NI4 (K, N), NI7 ((N, K) IGNORE NULL), NR3 ((K, N) IGNORE NULL after the rows), NI8 and NR8 (WITH DISALLOW NULL), NU1 (unique IGNORE NULL), NU2 (unique DISALLOW NULL) and NU3 (unique). Asks whether a row with a Null in the first, the second or both components is visible in the walk of an IGNORE NULL compound, which rows an index with DISALLOW NULL holds, and how the survivors of the unique variants order.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
